🎯 I Solved 350+ LeetCode SQL Problems... But Only These 20 Helped Me Crack Interviews. 

Wish someone had told me this earlier — if you’re prepping for SQL interviews, you don’t need to solve 300+ problems.
Instead, master these 20 handpicked gems that show up again and again in interviews at FAANG, startups, and top product-based companies.



📌 Top 20 SQL Questions That Truly Matter: (Save & Share this)

ai_analysis.summary: The post promotes a curated set of LeetCode SQL problems for interview preparation, arguing that mastering recurring questions matters more than solving 300 or more problems. Despite claiming to present 20 questions, it lists only 18 titles and provides no schemas, SQL techniques, solutions, or explanations. Its main takeaway is to solve the right problems with clarity and confidence.
